note: Public campground on the west shore of Pine Coulee Reservoir (a provincial off-stream water-management reservoir), 16 km west of Stavely on Hwy 527; recreation held by the MD of Willow Creek and operated since 2021 by the non-profit Stavely Elks Lodge. Boat launch. No generators in the main campground (allowed only at the group sites). --Claude
